name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based input buffer with 7 strategies per gamemode: predictive, landing, hybrid, min hold, min gap, grid and debounce.

sec-general.name: General
sec-general.description:
Predictive Input Buffer makes tight timings easier by fixing clicks that are a tiny bit too early, too short or would kill you.

**1 tick** = 1/240 s, about 4 ms.
**4 ticks** = 1 frame at 60 FPS (about 17 ms).
**8 ticks** = 2 frames, **16 ticks** = 4 frames.

All windows are in ticks of 1/240 s and are automatically converted to your real TPS.

**Note:** this is an input assist. Use it for practice and fun, not for leaderboard or submitted runs.

enabled.name: Enable Buffer
enabled.description: Master switch. Also toggled with the **Toggle Buffer** keybind (default F7).

preset.name: Preset
preset.description:
Quick setups. A preset **replaces the strategy of every gamemode** (the windows still come from the window settings below).

**Custom**: use the per-gamemode strategies below.
**Original v1**: the v1 trajectory buffer everywhere except ship.
**Classic Input Buffer**: Lyophi's MacOS mod: landing buffer on ground modes, min hold on ship/UFO/swing, grid on wave.
**Light**: only remembers early clicks before landing / orbs.
**Balanced**: hybrid on ground modes, predictive on UFO/swing/wave, min hold on ship.
**Aggressive**: hybrid everywhere, ship included.
**Consistency**: landing buffer + min hold + wave grid, for the most even timings.

main-window.name: Main Buffer Window (ticks)
main-window.description:
The default window used by every gamemode whose window is **-1**.

**0** = off.

**1 tick** = 1/240 s, about 4 ms.
**4 ticks** = 1 frame at 60 FPS (about 17 ms).
**8 ticks** = 2 frames, **16 ticks** = 4 frames.

All windows are in ticks of 1/240 s and are automatically converted to your real TPS.

The **Cycle Main Window** keybind (default F6) steps through 2, 4, 8, 16 and Off.

wave-cap.name: Wave Cap (ticks)
wave-cap.description: When the wave window is **-1**, it follows the Main Buffer Window but never goes above this value (v1 used 16 / 8). **0** = no cap.

tps.name: TPS (0 = Auto)
tps.description:
The physics ticks per second your game runs at.

**0 = Auto** (recommended): the mod measures it from the physics step, so TPS bypass from Mega Hack, Eclipse, etc. is detected automatically.

Set a value only if auto-detection is wrong.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs while in practice mode.

platformer.name: Enable in Platformer
platformer.description: Buffer the jump button in platformer levels too (left/right are never touched).

two-player.name: Buffer Player 2 (2-Player levels)
two-player.description: In 2-player levels, buffer player 2's inputs with the same rules as player 1.

cube-strategy.name: Cube Strategy
cube-strategy.description:
How cube inputs are buffered.

**Off**: raw input.
**Predictive**: simulates your trajectory. If the input would kill you but the same input a few ticks later survives, it is delayed to the earliest safe tick (up to the window).
**Landing Buffer**: a click made slightly before landing or before an orb is remembered and fired the moment you touch the ground or orb (if you already let go).
**Hybrid**: Landing Buffer for early clicks + Predictive for the rest.
**Grid Snap**: every press and release waits for the next line of a fixed N-tick grid. Very consistent, adds up to N ticks of delay.
**Debounce**: a press that comes less than N ticks after a release is ignored (fixes double clicks from worn switches).

cube-window.name: Cube Window (ticks)
cube-window.description:
Strength of the cube strategy.

**-1** = Main Buffer Window
**0** = off
**1+** = your own value

Predictive: max delay. Landing: how early a click is remembered. Min Hold / Min Gap / Grid / Debounce: their length.

sec-pred.name: Predictive tuning
sec-pred.description: Settings of the trajectory simulation used by Predictive and Hybrid.

predict-releases.name: Predict Releases
predict-releases.description: Also delay lethal **releases** in wave and robot (the only modes where a release changes the trajectory).

horizon-ground.name: Lookahead: Ground/Air (ticks)
horizon-ground.description: How far ahead the trajectory is checked for non-wave modes. Longer = sees more, costs more CPU per click. v1: 160.

horizon-wave.name: Lookahead: Wave (ticks)
horizon-wave.description: Lookahead for the big wave. v1: 65.

horizon-mini-wave.name: Lookahead: Mini Wave (ticks)
horizon-mini-wave.description: Lookahead for the mini wave. v1: 50.

strictness.name: Strictness
strictness.description:
How much a delayed input must gain before it is used.

**Strict**: only buffers when the delay clearly clears the obstacle.
**Normal**: v1 behaviour.
**Loose**: buffers more often.

spam-guard.name: Spam Guard
spam-guard.description: When you spam quickly (see below), the predictive buffer steps aside so fast wave spam stays 100% raw. Isolated micro-clicks stay protected.

spam-guard-all.name: Spam Guard on All Modes
spam-guard-all.description: Apply the spam guard to every gamemode instead of only wave.

spam-interval.name: Spam Interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Two inputs closer than this count as spam. v1: 8.

spam-streak.name: Spam Streak
spam-streak.description: Number of consecutive spam inputs before the buffer steps aside. v1: 3.

lethal-filter.name: Lethal Input Filter
lethal-filter.description:
**Strong assist.** If an input kills you whatever the delay, but NOT doing it survives the whole lookahead, the input is ignored (until you let go / press again).

Off by default.

landing-orbs.name: Fire on Orbs
landing-orbs.description: An early click is also fired when you touch an orb, not only the ground.

overlay.name: Show Overlay
overlay.description: Small status line while playing: gamemode, strategy, window, TPS and saved inputs.

overlay-flash.name: Flash on Save
overlay-flash.description: The overlay flashes cyan every time an input is saved by the buffer.

notify-hotkeys.name: Hotkey Notifications
notify-hotkeys.description: Show a small notification when a keybind changes a setting.

sec-keys.name: Keybinds
sec-keys.description: Only active while playing a level. Rebind them here or in Geode's keybind menu.

key-toggle.name: Toggle Buffer
key-toggle.description: Turns the whole buffer on / off.

key-cycle-window.name: Cycle Main Window
key-cycle-window.description: Steps the Main Buffer Window through 2, 4, 8, 16 ticks and Off.

key-cycle-strategy.name: Cycle Strategy (current gamemode)
key-cycle-strategy.description: Switches the strategy of the gamemode you are currently in (Custom preset only).

log-saves.name: Log Saved Inputs
log-saves.description: Writes every saved input to the Geode log ("*** SAVED +N TICKS ... ***").

console.name: Live Console Window
console.description: Opens the v1 live console window (Windows console) showing saved inputs as they happen.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.description: Very verbose logs of every queued / injected input. Leave off for normal play.
